name: Sunken Treasure
summary: In Faldir's Cove, Doctor Draxlegauge lends you his goggles to find ten elven gems for Captain O'Breen. He expects them back when you finish.

sections.title: Gems Turned to Stone
sections.body: The elven gems have lain on the sea floor so long that thick stone has hardened around them. The Goggles of Gem Hunting hold the power to find them through those stony shells. Proud of the gnomish ingenuity behind the goggles, Doctor Draxlegauge lends them to you. The gems are for Captain O'Breen.

sections.title: Dry Land for the Doctor
sections.body: Doctor Draxlegauge says scientific work keeps him on safe, dry land, though he could swim down himself. He expects you to return the goggles afterward. Captain O'Breen, he says, will have plenty of use for them.

faq.q: Who sends you to gather the gems?
faq.answer: Doctor Draxlegauge, waiting in Faldir's Cove, sends you to gather ten elven gems for Captain O'Breen.

faq.q: Why are special goggles required for the search?
faq.answer: Years on the sea floor have hardened the gems into thick stone. The power in the Goggles of Gem Hunting lets you find them easily.

faq.q: Why doesn't Doctor Draxlegauge dive for the gems himself?
faq.answer: Doctor Draxlegauge says important scientific work keeps him on safe, dry land.

faq.q: Can you keep the Goggles of Gem Hunting?
faq.answer: No. Doctor Draxlegauge lends you the goggles and expects them back when you finish. Captain O'Breen will use them often.

faq.q: Where does this fall in the Sunken Treasure chain?
faq.answer: This follows the first part of Sunken Treasure, when Professor Phizzlethorpe charged the goggles. A third part follows.
